cities.name: Oslo
cities.local_food_tip: Try seafood, fresh salmon, traditional Norwegian dishes, open‑faced sandwiches and local breads — simple but fresh Scandinavian flavours. 🐟🍞🥗
cities.full_day:
Morning: ☀️ Visit the Opera House and walk along the waterfront → Explore the city center and historic Akershus Fortress. → ☕ Coffee and pastry in central café.

Afternoon: 🖼️ Visit national museums (art, history or maritime) → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or fresh fish dish near the fjord.

Sunset: 🌇 Walk through Vigeland Park or waterfront promenades, enjoy sunset over city + sea/harbour.

Night: 🌃 Dinner in a cozy restaurant, maybe try local craft beer or dessert — relax in Nordic urban vibe under lights.

ideas: 🌸 Parks and waterfront start to bloom — perfect for strolls in mild weather.
🎨 Museums and galleries reopen after winter — ideal for cultural tours.
☕ Outdoor cafés and relaxed evenings by the sea or in town.
🌞 Long daylight hours — more time for sightseeing, walks along water and boat trips in fjord.
🍦 Ice cream, outdoor dining, vibrant street life and festivals.
🌅 Sunset promenades, midnight‑sun like light deep into evening.
🍁 Parks turn golden — nice for photos and calm walks.
🔥 Comfort food, warm drinks in cafés as days shorten.
🏛️ Museums and indoor spots perfect for cooler or rainy days.
❄️ Snow or crisp winter air — city looks calm and magical under soft light.
🏠 Warm meals, hot drinks and cozy evenings indoors.
✨ Festive lights around holidays, waterfront reflections and urban charm.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use metro, trams and buses — efficient for reaching all major spots quickly.
🚶 In city centre many attractions are walkable — good for pedestrians.
🚲 Bicycles or rental scooters good for waterfront and parks in fair weather.
🎟️ Consider city‑pass for transport + museums if plan to visit many sites.

city_events.name: Oslo Summer Waterfront Festival
city_events.description: 🎉 Music, street performances, open‑air markets and waterfront vibes under long summer days.

cities.name: Bergen
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh seafood — fish, shellfish, salmon, local breads and seasonal produce — ideal after fjord trips or coastal walks. 🍣🍞🦐
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🚤 Boat ride through nearby fjords or harbor → Walk historic wooden houses at Bryggen and old town. → ☕ Coffee near waterfront.

Afternoon: 🏔️ Hike or funicular up a nearby mountain for panoramic views → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood dish or local fish at a harbour restaurant.

Sunset: 🌇 Sunset from a viewpoint over city + mountains + fjord — breathtaking mix of water and peaks.

Night: 🌃 Dinner by the sea, stroll through narrow cobblestone streets, enjoy relaxed coastal‑city atmosphere.

ideas: 🌿 Fir‑green mountains and blossoming towns — perfect za planinarenje i istraživanje obale.
🚤 Boat rides before main tourist season — mir i priroda bez gužve.
☕ Waterfront cafés reopen — ideal za laganu šetnju i lokalnu hranu.
🏞️ Fjord cruises, kayaking, swimming or coastal hikes under mild Nordic sun.
🍷 Seafood lunches, dinners uz more i opuštena letnja atmosfera.
🛶 Long summer nights — ideal za izlete i istraživanje prirode i grada.
🍂 Planine i fjordovi pod zlatnim jesenskim tonovima — fotografije i mirne šetnje.
🔥 Topla jela i lokalni specijaliteti nakon izleta ili šetnji po kiši.
📸 Vodene površine + magla + jesenje boje — dramatični pejzaži.
❄️ Sneg na planinama + fjord + mir — za zimske avanture i planinarenje.
🏠 Kuhinja sa toplom hranom, resting in cosy cafés or cabins after cold day trips.
🌬️ Dramatic sea & fjord views — zimska moč­na priroda i čist vazduh.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Local buses connect city center with nearby fjords and villages — useful for fjord trips.
🚤 Ferries / boats for islands and coastal destinations — popular za istraživanje zapadne obale.
🚶 Historic centre is walkable — brojne drvene kuće i uske stare ulice idealne za pešake.
🎒 For fjord excursions — raspitaj se o voznim redovima i vremenskim uslovima.

city_events.name: Bergen Fjord & Mountains Festival
city_events.description: 🏞️ Activities, hiking, boat trips, local food & music — fjord lifestyle and mountain adventures combined.

cities.name: Stavanger
cities.local_food_tip: Seafood, fresh fish, shellfish, Norwegian style seafood stews and coastal dishes — ideal after fjord or sea excursions. 🐠🍲🦪
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌄 Boat or ferry ride toward nearby fjords (Lysefjord) → Walk through old town with wooden houses and historic streets. → ☕ Coffee in a harbour‑side café.

Afternoon: 🥾 Hike toward a famous viewpoint/rock over the fjord (like Preikestolen), enjoy panoramic sea + cliff views → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or fresh fish near harbour.

Sunset: 🌇 Coastal walk or cliff‑side spot for sunset over sea and fjord.

Night: 🌙 Dinner with coastal dishes, local beer or wine; relaxed harbour‑town atmosphere under Nordic sky.

ideas: 🌤️ Fjord waters calm, pleasant temperatures — good for boat rides and cliff hikes.
🚶 Explore old town and harbour before summer rush, enjoy peaceful coastal vibe.
🌿 Light weather ideal for coastal nature walks and seafood lunches outside.
⛵ Boat trips, fjord cruising, swimming or kayaking — full sea‑fjord adventure.
🍷 Seafood dinners by water, relaxed nights and mild sea breeze after hot days.
🎶 Summer festivals or small events in harbour or town square.
🍂 Cooler weather, golden light — ideal za planinarenje i more + prirodu kombinaciju.
🔥 Warm seafood meals and cosy indoor time after active days.
📸 Dramatic scenery: fjords + sea + jesenje boje — super za fotografije.
🌧️ Stormy sea, fjord mist — tajanstveno i moćno iskustvo prirode i klime.
🔥 Topla jela, lokalna kuhinja, miran grad — idealno za zimski beg.
🌌 Noćni pejzaži: fjord, voda i refleksije — posebna vrsta zimske atmosfere.

public_transport_tips: 🚢 Ferries connect to fjords and nearby islands — popular i praktično za izlete.
🚶 Old town i centar su pogodn i za pešake — istražuj na noge.
🚗 Za dublje ispitivanje prirode i planinskih delova — auto ili rent‑a‑car je poželjan.
🎫 Proveri lokalne ture/izlete — često nude prevoz + vodiča + povratak.

city_events.name: Stavanger Coastal & Fjord Festival
city_events.description: 🌊 Boat tours, fjord hikes, coastal food & sea‑life events — full Norwegian sea‑fjord vibe.

cities.name: Tromsø
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh Arctic fish, cod, salmon, reindeer meat, hearty soups and local Nordic dishes — perfect after cold outdoor adventures. 🐟🍲🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌄 Walk around town, visit Arctic cathedral or waterfront → ☕ Breakfast in cosy café.

Afternoon: 🚠 Take cable‑car up to nearby mountain (or hike) to enjoy panoramic views → 🍽️ Lunch: local seafood or traditional dish.

Sunset: 🌇 Fjord or island boat ride for serene sea/arctic panorama or stay in city for sunset light over Arctic harbor.

Night: 🌌 In winter — hunt for Northern Lights, join aurora tours or enjoy local nightlife in cosy bars; in summer — experience Midnight Sun, boat‑rides, long days, unique Arctic vibes.

ideas: 🌷 Snow melts, days lengthen — great for first hikes and town exploration.
🚣 Fjord boat rides or coastal walks as weather allows.
🥘 Try local seafood or hearty Arctic‑style meals indoors or at local taverns.
🌞 24‑hour daylight — perfect for hiking, sightseeing, boat tours and exploring nature all day.
🛶 Kayaking, fishing, island hopping or coastal hikes under long summer days.
🎶 Local festivals, outdoor events or relaxed Arctic‑city strolls deep in night light.

autumn.event: Autumn Colours & Northern Light Season Start
ideas: 🍂 Colorful tundra and forests — nice for photo‑hikes and nature walks.
🌌 First chances for Northern Lights — longer nights and clear skies.
🔥 Warm meals, local dishes and cosy atmosphere indoors after outdoor trips.
🌌 Aurora hunts: perfect time and location for Northern Lights viewing tours.
🐺 Winter activities: dog sledding, snow‑safaris, Arctic nature experiences.
🕯️ Cosy evenings, warm food, local culture — strong contrast sa surovom prirodom.

public_transport_tips: 🚐 Local buses for city & nearby areas; many tours include transport to Arctic areas — proveri rute.
🚶 City small — centar i waterfront su lako dostupni pešice.
🛳️ Boats & ferries for island hopping, fjord rides — popular opcija za prirodu i more.
🎯 Za planinske izlete ili Arctic avanture — organizovane ture i vodiči su najpouzdaniji.

city_events.name: Tromsø Northern Lights Festival
city_events.description: 🎼 Music, culture, winter events and Arctic spirit under Northern Lights sky.

cities.name: Trondheim
interests: Student & Youth Culture, Outdoor & Nature Nearby 🌿
cities.local_food_tip: Seafood, fish, local farm produce, breads and traditional Norwegian comfort dishes — fresh and balanced meals after city strolls or nature trips. 🐟🍞🥬
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Visit city's old district, historic cathedral and waterfront → ☕ Coffee in a local bakery or seaside café.

Afternoon: 🚶 Walk along fjord coast or nearby nature paths → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or local dish with vegetables / fish.

Sunset: 🌇 Fjord or coastal view, soft light on water, peaceful strolls or small boat ride.

Night: 🌃 Explore local culture — small concerts, student nightlife, relaxed restaurants and calm Nordic evening vibe.

ideas: 🌿 Green nature around city — good for walks and outdoor exploring.
🏙️ Historic centre + mild weather = ideal za razgledanje bez gužve.
🍷 Try local food & fresh seafood with light weather atmosphere.
🌞 Fjord swims, kayaking or coastal hikes nearby.
🎶 Festivals, student events and lively city vibe under dugim danima.
🍦 Ice‑cream, outdoor dinners and relaxed promenades by water.
🍂 Waterfront and nearby woods sa zlatnim jesenjim tonovima — super za foto‑setove i mirne šetnje.
🔥 Hearty meals, warm soups and cozy cafés tokom hladnijih dana.
🏛️ Museums, indoor posete kad je hladno ili kišovito.
❄️ Snow‑covered rooftops, fjord zaledjen ili miran — zimska atmosfera i tišina grada.
🔥 Topla jela, domaća hrana i lokalna kultura uz zimske večeri.
🎭 Manje gužve — idealno za istraživanje istorije i lokalnih običaja.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Local buses serve city and surrounding areas — korisno za izlete van centra.
🚶 Centre je kompaktan — idealno za pešačenje i istraživanje na noge.
🚤 Small boat rides or ferries for fjord/coast‑side trips — pitaj za lokalne ture.
🚗 If planiraš ruralne izlete — auto ili rent‑a‑car daje fleksibilnost.

city_events.name: Trondheim Summer Coast Festival
city_events.description: 🎉 Music, culture, coastal activities and community events — great mix of history and summer nature.
